FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 523
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Thomas Jackson
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/03/2026
House Bill 523 as introduced could, beginning February 1, 2027, increase the obligations of the
Alabama Department of Agriculture and Industries by an undetermined amount dependent on
the cost to administer the Alabama Agricultural Enhancement Program that the department may
establish, as provided by this bill. This program would provide cost share funds to agricultural
producers. However, these obligations could be offset, wholly or partially, by any legislative
appropriations, grants, contributions, or gifts deposited into the Alabama Agricultural
Enhancement Fund established by this bill to administer the program.
